title: Port inline manual editing and draft review
goal: Preserve the low-ceremony inline editing workflow while unifying accepted draft output with the proposal/audit system.
acceptance_criteria: Editable desktop reader blocks support p, li, h2, h3, and h4 edits
Undo and basic formatting controls exist without per-section save/cancel ceremony
Drafts autosave on transitions and are reviewed in a separate diff/lens-style surface
Accepted manual draft batches can enter the same Git/audit history path as accepted model proposals
non_goals: Raw Markdown editing in the normal UI
validation: Desktop smoke for section edit, undo, autosave, draft review, and rejection
Hash-check accepted draft output before write
notes: Keep manual edits and model proposals separate at input time, but converge on the same review/audit outputs. One accepted model proposal or approved manual-draft batch creates one Git commit by default.
